statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness that have persisted despite initial rate control therapy.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
The claim is for CPT code 93247.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial is based on the required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before the service was rendered.
